name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
portability: 100% Nationwide Portability across any empanelled hospital in India

states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
eligibility_rules.summary: Flagship national health insurance covering over 55 crore citizens across all 36 States & UTs. 1,949+ medical, surgical, oncology, and neurosurgery procedures covered with full interstate portability.

covered_conditions.package_details: Covers craniotomy, excision of brain tumors, skull base surgery, aneurysm clipping, VP shunt for hydrocephalus, and spinal cord decompression. Includes pre-op MRI/CT, ICU ventilator care, and post-op rehabilitation. 100% cashless.
Hemodialysis package including dialyzer reuse, erythropoietin injections, and monthly nephrologist review. Fully cashless.
Covers PTCA stenting, Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG), valve replacement, pacemaker implantation, and emergency ICU stabilization.
Surgical tumor resection, systemic chemotherapy cycles, targeted molecular therapy, linear accelerator radiotherapy, and palliative supportive care.
Total Knee Replacement (TKR), Total Hip Replacement (THR), complex pelvic/polytrauma internal fixation, arthroscopy, and bone tumor reconstruction.
Phacoemulsification cataract surgery with foldable IOL lens, vitrectomy for retinal detachment, glaucoma filtration surgery, and corneal transplant.
Laparoscopic cholecystectomy, common bile duct exploration, liver resection, GI hemorrhage management, and complex intestinal obstruction surgery.
High-risk institutional delivery, emergency Caesarean section, neonatal nursery/NICU care for neonates, and postpartum complications.
Hernioplasty (Inguinal/Incisional hernia), appendectomy, exploratory laparotomy, abscess drainage, and diabetic foot wound debridement.
Correction of congenital anomalies (anorectal malformation, tracheoesophageal fistula, congenital diaphragmatic hernia), pediatric oncology, and Level III NICU care.
Severe pneumonia ICU management, acute respiratory failure on mechanical ventilation, bronchoscopy, and pleural effusion drainage.
Acute ischemic stroke thrombolysis (tPA), status epilepticus ICU management, Guillain-Barré syndrome IVIG therapy, and myasthenia gravis crisis.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY Maharashtra)
sponsor: State Health Assurance Society (Govt of Maharashtra)
coverage_limit: ₹5,00,000 per family per year (Universal for all ration card holders)

eligibility_rules.summary: Universal state health coverage for all resident families in Maharashtra. Covers 1,356 packages across 34 specialized medical and surgical categories at empanelled network hospitals.

covered_conditions.package_details: Brain tumor surgeries, craniotomy for trauma, aneurysm treatment at KEM, JJ Hospital, and empanelled private super-specialties across Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur.
Coronary bypass, coronary angioplasty with drug-eluting stents, valve surgeries, and pediatric heart interventions.
Comprehensive cancer care at Tata Memorial Centre and state network hospitals.
Cashless hemodialysis and renal failure therapy across Maharashtra municipal and district hospitals.

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS Tamil Nadu)
sponsor: Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project (Govt of Tamil Nadu)

eligibility_rules.summary: Covers 1,513 procedures across government medical colleges and empanelled private hospitals in Tamil Nadu with integrated Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY benefits.

covered_conditions.package_details: Microvascular craniotomy, brain tumor excision, acoustic neuroma removal at Rajiv Gandhi Govt General Hospital, Stanley, and CMC Vellore.
Complete cashless cardiac care including CABG, angioplasty, and congenital heart repairs.
Chemo, radiation, and onco-surgery at Adyar Cancer Institute and state medical colleges.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana (MMJAY Uttar Pradesh)
sponsor: State Agency for Comprehensive Health & Integrated Services (SACHIS UP)

eligibility_rules.summary: Covers eligible families omitted from SECC in Uttar Pradesh, providing exact parity with PM-JAY benefits across 3,000+ empanelled hospitals in UP.

covered_conditions.package_details: Brain and spinal neurosurgical procedures at KGMU Lucknow, SGPGI, and AIIMS Gorakhpur.
Interventional cardiology and cardiac bypass surgeries.
Maintenance hemodialysis under UP State Free Dialysis Program.

name: Delhi Arogya Kosh & Central PM-JAY (Delhi NCT)
sponsor: Directorate General of Health Services (Govt of NCT of Delhi / NHA)
coverage_limit: ₹5,00,000 under PM-JAY / Up to ₹5 Lakh under DAK Financial Assistance

eligibility_rules.summary: Provides cashless specialized treatments, expensive surgeries, and high-end diagnostic tests at premier apex institutes (AIIMS, Safdarjung, GB Pant, ILBS) and empanelled private hospitals in Delhi.

covered_conditions.package_details: Advanced neurosurgical operations and micro-neurosurgery at AIIMS New Delhi and GB Pant Hospital.
Open heart surgery, valve replacement, and cardiac pacing.
Comprehensive oncology at Dr. BRA IRCH (AIIMS) and Delhi State Cancer Institute.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana (MMJAY Bihar)
sponsor: Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti (Govt of Bihar)

eligibility_rules.summary: Covers all NFSA ration-card holding families in Bihar who were omitted from the original 2011 SECC list, giving parity with PM-JAY benefits.

covered_conditions.package_details: Neurosurgery and head trauma surgery at AIIMS Patna, IGIMS, and PMCH.
Hemodialysis at district medical colleges and empanelled private centers across Bihar.
Stenting, bypass surgeries, and interventional cardiac treatments at IGIMS, AIIMS, and empanelled cardiac centers.
Emergency surgical deliveries and maternal intensive care in government & empanelled facilities.
Chemotherapy & surgical oncology at Mahavir Cancer Sansthan, IGIMS, and AIIMS Patna.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka (ArK)
sponsor: Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (Govt of Karnataka)
coverage_limit: ₹5,00,000 / family (Cat A Eligible), up to ₹1,50,000 (Cat B General)

eligibility_rules.summary: Universal healthcare covering Category A (BPL/Eligible households - 100% cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh) and Category B (APL/General - 30% financial assistance at govt package rates).

covered_conditions.package_details: Specialized cranial and spinal neurosurgical procedures at NIMHANS, Victoria Hospital, and empanelled neuro-centers in Karnataka.
Free maintenance hemodialysis at INU, Victoria Hospital, KIMS, and taluk level dialysis centers.
Comprehensive cardiac intervention at Sri Jayadeva Institute and Narayana Health City without out-of-pocket costs for Cat A.
High-risk pregnancy care, C-sections, and neonatal care at Vani Vilas and Cheluvamba Hospitals.
Comprehensive multidisciplinary cancer therapy at Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology.

name: Mukhya Mantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (MAAY Rajasthan)
coverage_limit: Up to ₹25,00,000 cashless insurance per family per year

eligibility_rules.summary: Provides unprecedented cashless coverage up to ₹25 Lakh for all resident families in Rajasthan across 1,800+ procedures.

covered_conditions.package_details: Neurosurgical craniotomies and spine surgeries at SMS Hospital Jaipur and AIIMS Jodhpur.
Complete heart bypass and stenting at government and empanelled private hospitals.

name: Swasthya Sathi Scheme (West Bengal)
sponsor: Department of Health & Family Welfare (Govt of West Bengal)
coverage_limit: ₹5,00,000 per family per year (Smart Card in name of Female Head)

eligibility_rules.summary: Universal secondary & tertiary health cover for all families in West Bengal with smart card issued to female head of household.

covered_conditions.package_details: Brain tumor surgeries and neuro-trauma care at SSKM Hospital (IPGMER) and Bangur Institute of Neurosciences.
CABG bypass, pediatric heart surgery at Rabindranath Tagore International Institute and Medical College Kolkata.
